content.text: {"steps":[{"id":"s1","description":"Use list_documents, then read candidate_specs.md and any project documents that define the allocated Level-1 rate, latency estimates, and simulation/threshold conventions. Extract the three allowed candidate algorithms, their FPGA latencies, and the allowed threshold range."},{"id":"s2","description":"Filter the candidates to those with documented Level-1 FPGA latency <= 4.0 us. Assign each allowed algorithm a numeric code for recording, and record each candidate's latency and eligibility flag using record_results."},{"id":"s3","description":"For every latency-eligible candidate, run simulate_efficiency at thresholds 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50, 55, and 60 GeV. Record each numeric efficiency result, along with its algorithm code and threshold."},{"id":"s4","description":"Identify the best-performing simulated point that satisfies efficiency >= 80%. If the best point is not clearly at a boundary, run additional simulate_efficiency scans in 1 GeV steps over a narrow window around the best coarse threshold; if it is at a boundary, scan the nearest allowed 1 GeV steps inward. Record all refined efficiencies."},{"id":"s5","description":"Select the latency-eligible algorithm and threshold with the highest recorded signal efficiency among points satisfying efficiency >= 80% and threshold between 20 and 60 GeV. Record the selected algorithm code, threshold, efficiency, and latency so the reporting module can submit the final recommendation."}]}

output.arguments: {"option":"Algorithm-L2","threshold_gev":40,"justification":"No candidate has a documented Level-1 FPGA latency estimate, so no fully valid selection satisfying all hard requirements was found. This recommendation is therefore conditional/non-compliant with respect to the hard latency requirement until an FPGA latency estimate demonstrates <= 4.0 us.","requirements":[{"requirement":"Algorithm must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.","status":"met","evidence":"Algorithm-L2 is allowed/listed (Algorithm_L2_allowed = 1)."},{"requirement":"Signal efficiency at the allocated rate must be at least 80%.","status":"met","evidence":"Best recorded point is Algorithm-L2 at 40 GeV with s4_best_efficiency_pct = 92.561 at allocated_L1_rate_kHz = 8; s4_best_satisfies_efficiency_requirement = 1."},{"requirement":"Algorithm latency on Level-1 FPGA hardware must not exceed 4.0 us.","status":"unknown","evidence":"No latency estimates were found or documented: latency_estimates_found = 0, Algorithm_L2_latency_documented = 0, Algorithm_L2_L1FPGA_latency_us = -1.
